tldr: For a fixed finite labeled BGCM graph, deleting the target column and both candidate rows exposes a canonical set \(R\), and a query is universally robust over the published clusterwise-solvable BGCM envelope exactly when it avoids \(R\).  The universal total-variation contrast has an attained maximum of zero or one accordingly.  Robust queries receive a shared named DM-interface certificate.  For nonrobust queries, one finite exact-incidence affine structure attains one when its unrestricted actual exogenous law is the point mass at zero; the same structure also supports independent full-support laws whose contrasts approach one.  The singleton field \(\mathbb F_7\), the simultaneous field of size below \(2(n+4)\), and the separate deterministic algorithmic field serve distinct constructive roles.
gap: BGCM work makes equation identity causal and shows same-value ambiguity, while causal-ordering results give one-intervention non-effects. Inspected literature does not characterize two arbitrary same-target replacements over every compatible model-clamp pair or give a legal finite separator when equality is not forced.
